namePolicy: Only listed variants are used for candidate matching. Primary labels remain available. Names are not proof of publication subject or equivalent site boundaries. Short ambiguous names, textual fragments, generic descriptions and constituent-location names are excluded. Names of modern cities and governorates (Cairo, Damietta, Minya, Fayum), regions (Nile Delta), a pharaoh (Ramesses) and the Rosetta Stone are excluded because they refer to things other than the ancient site.
